items.guides: Help menu item: opens the product's guides.
items.whats-new: Help menu item: opens the release notes.
items.new: Screen-reader label of the count of releases the person hasn't seen.
shortcuts.title: Help menu item and the title of the dialog listing keyboard shortcuts.
shortcuts.description: Under that title: the shortcuts work anywhere in the app.
shortcuts.search: What the shortcut does: opens the search palette.
shortcuts.ask: What the shortcut does: opens the panel to ask a socio (an AI agent).
shortcuts.sidebar: What the shortcut does, in the keyboard shortcuts dialog: hides or shows the sidebar.
get-the-app.title: Title of the dialog with a QR code for the mobile app; also the label of the banner offering it. "Socio" is the product name.
get-the-app.description: Text of the dialog with a QR code for the mobile app. "Socio" is the product name; "team beta" means only some testers have the app so far.
get-the-app.code: Alternative text of the QR code image.
get-the-app.banner: Banner on a phone's browser offering the mobile app.
get-the-app.not-now: Screen-reader label of the banner's close button.
theme.title: Label of the color theme choice (light, dark or the system's).
theme.light: Theme choice, in the Help menu and the command palette: always use the light colors.
theme.dark: Theme choice, in the Help menu and the command palette: always use the dark colors.
theme.system: Theme choice: follow the device's light or dark setting.
account.get-app: Account menu item (the menu under the person's name in the sidebar): opens a QR code for the Socio mobile app.
account.release-notes: Account menu item: opens the release notes.
account.add-device: Account menu item: opens the dialog that signs a phone or another device in to this workspace with a code.
account.account: Account menu item, for a test user: opens their account settings.
account.account-security: Account menu item: opens the person's account and sign-in security settings (passkeys, password).
account.sign-out: Account menu item: signs the person out.
account.switch-user: Account menu item, for test users: signs in as another one.
passkey.add: Sidebar row suggesting a passkey after a sign-in without one; it opens the account settings. A passkey signs in with a fingerprint, face or PIN.
passkey.not-now: Tooltip and accessible name of the × that hides that row for good.
